name: Full ASU Medical Portal Overhaul
description:
Build ALL 10 waves of the ASU Medical Portal improvement plan in one overnight session:

1. Install missing dependencies (zustand, zod, vite-plugin-pwa)
2. Download and normalize 5 Freesound samples
3. Expand Question types with difficulty, bloomLevel, tags, estimatedTimeSeconds, media
4. Add Zod runtime validation schemas
5. Add heuristic difficulty/bloom assignment at data load time
6. Fix remaining `any` types in data.ts
7. Build sound engine with 5 samples + mute toggle
8. Add micro-interactions on all buttons (scale, hover glow, active press)
9. Add custom cursor for desktop (glowing orb, color shift)
10. Build countdown timer hook with exam/practice/off modes
11. Build circular SVG timer ring with urgency colors
12. Add exam mode settings panel (20/40/60/80 question count)
13. Build gamification store (XP, level, streak) with Zustand + persist
14. Add XP/streak/level HUD in quiz interface
15. Add daily streak heatmap calendar (GitHub-style)
16. Add "weakest topics" auto-recommendation card
17. Add module-themed confetti (color-coded per module)
18. Add 3D card flip reveal on answer
19. Add glassmorphism dashboard cards with hover lift
20. Add module completion ring charts
21. Add global prefers-reduced-motion support
22. Add aria-live quiz announcements for screen readers
23. Add focus traps in overlays
24. Expand service worker precache with workbox manifest
25. Add route prefetching
26. Add loading skeletons for async content

After ALL waves are built, run a full recheck: npm test, npm run build, npx tsc --noEmit, review all new files, verify no dangling threads, no TODOs, no placeholders.

Every wave must independently build + test + commit. No wave proceeds until its verification gate passes.
